summary: HSPnetGridView is a custom grid view control that extends System.Web.UI.WebControls.GridView to provide enhanced paging functionality. It supports toggling between paged and 'Show All' modes, and renders a numeric pager with next/previous navigation, ellipsis for jump navigation, and dynamic button/caption updating.
purpose: To display tabular data with flexible paging options, enabling users to navigate through pages, show all records, and interact with a customized numeric pager that mimics advanced paging controls.

fields.name: StartRow
fields.description: Index of the first row to display based on current paging settings.

actors.name: User
actors.description: Interacts with the pager controls to navigate, show all records, or select specific pages.

actors.name: System
actors.description: Renders pager, handles page navigation, and displays appropriate data based on paging state.

workflows.name: Paging Navigation
steps: User clicks a numeric page button, next/prev button, or ellipsis.
System updates PageIndex and displays the appropriate page.
If 'Show All' is chosen, PageSize is set to a maximum value to disable paging.
If returning to paged mode, PageSize is reset to the default value.
Paging caption updates to reflect the current state (Show All or Show X).

workflows.name: Pager Rendering
steps: Pager control calculates start and end page indices to display.
Adds prev/next buttons, numeric page buttons or labels, ellipsis buttons for jumps, and spacers.
Hides paging caption if only one page.

business_rules: Paging caption is hidden if there is only one page and defaultPageSize is used.
Show All disables paging by using a very high page size.
Page buttons, labels, and ellipsis are dynamically rendered based on current and total page indices.
validations: StartRow is set based on PageIndex and PageSize; if PageSize is zero, PageIndex is unchanged.
Page navigation buttons only appear if multiple pages exist.
calculations: startPageIndex = PageIndex - 4; adjusted for edge cases
endPageIndex = PageIndex + 5; adjusted for edge cases
conditions: If PageSize < maxPageSize, Show All mode is active; otherwise, paged mode is used.
If PageCount == 1 and PageSize == defaultPageSize, paging controls are hidden.
Ellipsis buttons are shown if there are more pages to jump to beyond the displayed range.
system_behavior: Pager dynamically updates navigation controls and caption based on paging state.
Grid view responds to paging commands and adjusts displayed data accordingly.
Controls (LinkButton, Label, Literal) are used to render pager UI.
dependencies: Depends on System.Web.UI.WebControls.GridView for base functionality.
Uses Resources for localizing button/caption text.
Requires properly set PageIndex, PageSize, PageCount, and control container for pager rendering.
exceptions: If PageSize is zero, StartRow assignment defaults to PageIndex.
If only one page exists, paging controls (including caption) are hidden.
content_gaps: No details are provided about error handling beyond hiding paging controls for single-page scenarios.
UI rendering specifics (visual design, accessibility) are not described.
Integration points with data source are not covered.
